title: Detailed wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Watch strap top -->
  <rect x="40" y="5" width="20" height="28" rx="3" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <rect x="42" y="5" width="16" height="28" rx="2" fill="#A0704A"/>
  <!-- Strap holes -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="10" r="1.5" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="16" r="1.5" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="1.5" fill="#5C3A1E"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="28" r="1.5" fill="#5C3A1E"/>

  <!-- Watch strap bottom -->
  <rect x="40" y="67" width="20" height="28" rx="3" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <rect x="42" y="67" width="16" height="28" rx="2" fill="#A0704A"/>
  <!-- Buckle -->
  <rect x="45" y="80" width="10" height="8" rx="1" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <rect x="47" y="82" width="6" height="4" rx="1" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="84" r="1" fill="#D4AF37"/>

  <!-- Watch case outer -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="22" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <!-- Watch case inner rim -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="19" fill="#C0A030"/>
  <!-- Watch face -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="17" fill="#1A1A2E"/>

  <!-- Hour markers -->
  <!-- 12 -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="34" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#F0E68C"/>
  <!-- 3 -->
  <rect x="61" y="48.5" width="5" height="3" rx="1" fill="#F0E68C"/>
  <!-- 6 -->
  <rect x="48.5" y="61" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#F0E68C"/>
  <!-- 9 -->
  <rect x="34" y="48.5" width="5" height="3" rx="1" fill="#F0E68C"/>
  <!-- 1, 2 -->
  <rect x="54" y="35.5" width="2.5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E8D87A" transform="rotate(30 55 37.5)"/>
  <rect x="57.5" y="40" width="2.5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E8D87A" transform="rotate(60 58.5 42)"/>
  <!-- 4, 5 -->
  <rect x="57.5" y="56" width="2.5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E8D87A" transform="rotate(-60 58.5 58)"/>
  <rect x="54" y="60.5" width="2.5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E8D87A" transform="rotate(-30 55 62.5)"/>
  <!-- 7, 8 -->
  <rect x="43.5" y="60.5" width="2.5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E8D87A" transform="rotate(30 45 62.5)"/>
  <rect x="40" y="56" width="2.5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E8D87A" transform="rotate(60 41.5 58)"/>
  <!-- 10, 11 -->
  <rect x="40" y="40" width="2.5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E8D87A" transform="rotate(-60 41.5 42)"/>
  <rect x="43.5" y="35.5" width="2.5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#E8D87A" transform="rotate(-30 45 37.5)"/>

  <!-- Minute markers (small dots) -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="33.5" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="34.5" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="61.5" cy="38" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="44" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="66.5" cy="50" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="56" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="61.5" cy="62" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="65.5" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="66.5" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="65.5" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="38.5" cy="62" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="56" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="33.5" cy="50" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="44" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="38.5" cy="38" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="34.5" r="0.6" fill="#888"/>

  <!-- Hour hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="43" y2="42" stroke="#F0E68C" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Minute hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="58" y2="38" stroke="#F0E68C" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Second hand -->
  <line x1="50" y1="50" x2="50" y2="62" stroke="#FF6347" stroke-width="0.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="0.7" fill="#FF6347"/>

  <!-- Crown -->
  <rect x="70" y="47" width="5" height="6" rx="1" fill="#D4AF37"/>
  <rect x="72" y="48" width="1" height="1" fill="#C0A030"/>
  <rect x="74" y="48" width="1" height="1" fill="#C0A030"/>
  <rect x="72" y="51" width="1" height="1" fill="#C0A030"/>
  <rect x="74" y="51" width="1" height="1" fill="#C0A030"/>

  <!-- Crown stem -->
  <rect x="71" y="49" width="1" height="2" fill="#B8960F"/>
</svg>
